backupIntro: All lists, chores, recipes and settings, encrypted in one file — for a new phone or just in case. It cannot be read without the password.
backupPassphraseCreateHint: Choose a password for the backup. It cannot be restored without it — keep it safe!
backupRestoreConfirmText: Shopping list, chores, recipes and settings on this device will be replaced by the backup. If you share your household, the devices sync again afterwards — newer changes from the others are kept.
backupTooNew: This backup is from a newer app version. Please update the app.
backupWrongApp: This is not a Household backup.
